items: Menu engineering sorts each item by popularity and profitability into stars, plow horses, puzzles and dogs, so you can promote, reprice, rethink or remove it.
Combine sales data with review sentiment to see what's selling and why, and test changes on your app or delivery menu before rolling them out to every store.
Layout shapes what guests order, so place high-margin items where eyes land first, use price anchoring and test what you show first or in bold.
Change a little at a time, keep listening to guest feedback on new items, drop dogs kept out of habit and adapt menus to regional tastes.
